task.description: Produce ADP-12 test design artifacts aligned to implemented regression suite behavior. Create or refine test spec coverage for default-tenant pre/post migration equivalence assertions, canonicalization exclusions, deterministic diff/report artifacts, and failure classification. Ensure test design maps directly to executable integration tests and release gating for ADP-12.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-12 spec clearly maps acceptance criteria to executable tests
Spec defines deterministic pass/fail criteria for zero-diff invariants
Coverage includes canonicalization exclusions and flaky-signal handling
Artifacts and report paths expected from test execution are documented

result.summary: Test design artifacts for ADP-12 now map requirement acceptance to executable integration tests, deterministic zero-diff pass/fail criteria, canonicalization exclusion boundaries, flaky-signal handling, and expected ADP-12 report outputs.
